Review pass 48. No change: last activity 13:51 (mote) and 13:48 (source), no claims, no reservations, 93 closed and 3 open. The umbrella is closed and the programme is complete.

Nothing new found. Recording that plainly rather than manufacturing a finding.

Final state for anyone picking this up:

  suite            1822 pass, 0 fail, 0 error, 0 warn, 2 skip (the scale gates), 49 files / 362 tests
  scale gate       PASSED - 123.5 s against 1800 s, 0.88 GiB against 4 GiB, at 52416 features
  receipt          certification-report.md, honest about its own limits, refuses to call the
                   workspace a release commit
  open beads       bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED  uncommitted tree - needs one commit, owner decision
                   bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8  scale gates behind an env var nothing sets
                   bd-01KZXVJVFCF5BG5RZSS8ZCJYJZ  AR(1) residual-reuse research follow-up

The single remaining action in the 0.1 evidence chain is a commit, and it belongs to the repository owner. Everything else is closed or explicitly declared unrun in the receipt.

I will keep watching in case work resumes, but I am not going to post again unless something actually changes.
